P.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Scarecrow Effigy:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' begins the game with an exclusive {{ii|Scarecrow Effigy}}, which permanently occupies the [[Trinket item|trinket]] slot. '''Fiddlesticks''' can pretend to be an ''Effigy'' by standing still and not acting nor being acted upon for 2 seconds, during which it hides its [[health bar]], adjusts its body into a scarecrow and extends its arm out to expose its lantern.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - A Harmless Scarecrow:}} From {{stil|experience|level}} 6 onward, placing an {{tip|Effigy}} also summons a {{tip|Sweeper Drone}} at the location for 6 seconds.

Q.name: Terrify
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Fiddlesticks''' has been [[combat status|out of combat]] for at least {{tt|{{fd|2.25}} seconds|Estimated}} and is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to the enemy team, or is impersonating an ''{{ai|A Harmless Scarecrow|Fiddlesticks|Effigy}}'', its damaging ability will additionally {{tip|fear}} targets hit for a duration.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' launches a crow at the target enemy which arrives after {{tt|{{fd|0.35}} seconds|Fixed travel time from the start of the cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|fear|fearing}} them for a duration. ''Terrify'' has a minimum damage threshold and is capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description3: Targets feared by '''Fiddlesticks''' by any means cannot be affected by it again for a duration equal to ''Terrify's'' cooldown. Against these targets, ''Terrify's'' {{ccs|damage|magic}} and minimum threshold are doubled.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Increased Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|4*2 to 6*2}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3*2}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''current''' health}}}}
{{st|Increased Minimum Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}}}}

W.name: Bountiful Harvest
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' forms a {{tip|tether}} between itself and each nearby enemy over the cast time, then {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 2 seconds to harvest their souls, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in the process.
W.description2: While '''Fiddlesticks''' is channeling, the tethered enemies are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. The final tick at the end of the channel deals additional {{as|magic damage}}, capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}. ''Bountiful Harvest'' deals {{ap|1.35*100}}% damage against {{tip|monsters}} and {{ap|0.50*100}}% damage against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Damage per second|{{ap|120/2 to 360/2}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#expr:90/2}}}}% AP)}}|Damage per Instance|{{ap|120/{{#var:total_ticks}} to 360/{{#var:total_ticks}}}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#expr:90/{{#var:total_ticks}}}}}}% AP)}}}}{{st|Last Tick of Damage|{{ap|120/{{#var:total_ticks}} to 360/{{#var:total_ticks}}}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#expr:90/{{#var:total_ticks}}}}}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12 to 22}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|120 to 360}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12 to 22}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
W.description3: '''Fiddlesticks''' {{tip|heals}} itself for a portion of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage dealt before modifiers}} dealt, modified to {{ap|0.45*100}}% against {{tip|monsters}} and {{ap|0.15*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
W.description4: ''Bountiful Harvest'' ends if all targets have died or broken their tethers. If the channel was not {{tt|interrupted|e.g. by Fiddlesticks or crowd control effects}}, 60% of the {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is refunded.
W.description5: ''A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be tethered by this ability.''

E.name: Reap
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' slashes the target location with its scythe, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
E.description2: Enemies hit in the center of the area are also {{tip|silence|silenced}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

R.name: Crowstorm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiddlesticks''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, then {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location upon completion with a murder of crows flying wildly around it for 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to nearby enemies.
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|150*0.25 to 350*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{fd|12.5}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|150*5 to 350*5}} {{as|(+ 250% AP)}}}}
